scope: Accepted Rama resource contract and authoring compatibility; templates are not completed roster heroes.

roster.name: Rama
roster.unique_requirements: Accepted source; not a new roster output.
roster.catalog_silhouette: A long calm vertical silhouette; one crescent bow taller than the shoulder; split cobalt sash balanced by a narrow ivory waist.

roster.name: Ravana
roster.unique_requirements: Unique grip, chakram dynamics/release and ten-facet crown; current design has one head.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Broad trapezoid mantle, low deliberate centre of mass and ten crown facets contained within one readable head outline.

roster.name: Arjuna
roster.unique_requirements: Unique lean silhouette, face, angular bow, quiver, scarf and pivot choreography.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Lean diagonal stance, long angular bow, high off-centre quiver and a split shoulder scarf distinct from Rama’s vertical sash.

roster.name: Duryodhana
roster.unique_requirements: Unique heavy grip, swing/recovery, hit contacts and silhouette.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Square shoulder silhouette, compact crown, thick forearms and a mace head wider than the hero’s head; clear air between weapon and torso.

roster.name: Hanuman
roster.unique_requirements: Tail anatomy/rig/secondary motion, mace contacts and airborne/landing choreography.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Powerful upper body with an open face, one curved tail counterbalancing the mace and a long saffron scarf with a readable split end.

roster.name: Karna
roster.unique_requirements: Unique broad proportions, face, shoulder discs, bow and deliberate draw.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Heavy archer silhouette with paired shoulder discs, crescent bow and a single long amber sash; broader and slower than Arjuna.

roster.name: Bhima
roster.unique_requirements: Unique broad proportions, heavy weapon, contact and recovery choreography.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Broad powerful torso, crossed straps, asymmetric waist cloth and a long-headed mace carried low enough to keep the face clear.

roster.name: Meghnad
roster.unique_requirements: Unique compact bow, face, forked crest, cloud scarf and oblique footwork.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Lean forward silhouette, forked crest, compact bow and layered cloud scarf swept to one side rather than forming an opaque cloak.

roster.name: Sita
roster.unique_requirements: Unique anatomy/face/mantle, staff grips and protective gestures.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Grounded poised silhouette, seed-shaped crest, long emerald/ivory mantle and a leaf-tipped staff with a clear curved opening.

roster.name: Draupadi
roster.unique_requirements: Unique anatomy/face, five-panel cloth, staff and command gestures.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Upright narrow staff, strong vertical crown and a five-point mantle clasp; layered wine-coloured cloth falls in five broad readable panels.

roster.name: Subhadra
roster.unique_requirements: Unique anatomy/face, spear/pennant grip and command gestures.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Spear pennant, rounded shoulder guards and a strong side braid; asymmetric short command cape leaves both legs readable.

roster.name: Hidimbi
roster.unique_requirements: Unique broad humanoid design, leaf mantle, spear and grounding.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Powerful broad leaf mantle with a clear shoulder line, braided crest and forked spear; expressive humanoid face, no generic monster replacement.

roster.name: Chitrangada
roster.unique_requirements: Unique anatomy/face, spear transfers and crossing footwork.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Athletic spear-duelist stance, crescent spear, braided knot and a short segmented mantle that exposes purposeful leg motion.

roster.name: Ulupi
roster.unique_requirements: Unique humanoid anatomy/face, circular staff grips and garment motion; current design retains legs.
roster.catalog_silhouette: Flowing grounded silhouette, wave crest, scale-edged collar and water-ring staff; humanoid legs and face stay readable beneath layered blue-green cloth.

secondary_motion.method: bounded shader displacement; not physical cloth
